Browser companies like Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Mozilla responded by blocking these certificates rapidly. eMudhra explained that a flaw during the creation process led to the publication of the weak keys. Importantly, no evidence suggests these weak keys were used in actual attacks so far.

The 3.5-acre property featured a sprawling mansion, two swimming pools, a tennis court and stunning Golden Gate Bridge views. After nearly four years on the market, the couple reduced the asking price several times. High maintenance costs and the home's dated interiors reportedly made selling difficult.
